message.content: The community garden plans include adding a small water feature, which is expected to add a soothing sound and attract wildlife. Additionally, to enhance the comfort and aesthetics of the seating areas on sunny days, the proposal includes incorporating umbrellas and plants around the seating area. Specifically, Muradin Bronzebeard suggested adding umbrellas, which would help make the seating area more comfortable during the hot days. Furthermore, he proposed placing plants around the seating area to create a more natural and secluded environment. This approach not only makes the space more comfortable for sitting but also adds a natural and tranquil ambiance.
